definitions.explanation: The administrative office of a Shinto shrine, where visitors can purchase amulets, charms, and other items, and where shrine administrative work is conducted.

examples.japanese: {社務所|しゃむしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a charm at the shrine office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{御朱印|ごしゅいん}→御朱印：16927_goshuin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社務所|しゃむしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: You can get a shrine stamp at the shrine office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祈祷|きとう}→祈祷：22031_kitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社務所|しゃむしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けている→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Applications for Shichi-Go-San prayer ceremonies are accepted at the shrine office.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (shrine) + {務|む} (duties, affairs) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place). The {社務所|しゃむしょ} is typically a building near the main shrine building where priests and staff handle administrative tasks and interact with visitors. It is the place to go for purchasing ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧ (charms), ⟦{御朱印|ごしゅいん}→御朱印：16927_goshuin⟧ (seal stamps), and arranging prayer ceremonies.
